# v1.21.4b2 — Optional house-load comparison sensors

Development beta for [issue #10](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/issues/10). It adds experiments alongside the existing implementation; the default house-load calculation and control inputs remain unchanged.

## Added

- **House Load Median 5 (Comparison)** — an odd-sized trailing median of up to five accepted samples within ten seconds; `window_samples` identifies warm-up or slower-polling windows.
- **House Load Battery Step (Comparison)** — holds its previous accepted result when both battery and house-load power change by more than 2 kW, limited to two fresh samples or four elapsed seconds, whichever comes first.

Both sensors are diagnostic, disabled by default and use data already read by the integration. They add no Modbus requests. Fresh unchanged polls count; cached/partial callbacks and estimated source values cannot fill their histories or extend a hold. Missing/stale input, long gaps, mode changes and restart reset the experiments. Entity-only timers expire results without invoking controllers.

## Test without changing working inputs

Enable the two disabled sensors under the AlphaESS device's entities **while no dispatch is active**. Home Assistant can reload the integration when an entity is enabled. Keep the original house-load and energy sensors and all control mappings selected as before; record the comparison sensors alongside them.

Both experiments can hide genuine short loads, including a four-second 3 kW increase supplied by the battery. A battery step is not proof of a dispatch event or an inconsistent reading. These are not recommended control or energy inputs. No experimental energy totals are created; compare energy offline with proper treatment of unknown intervals and estimate expiry.

Existing house-load/filtered readings, accumulated totals, register command paths and PredBat settings are unchanged. This beta also contains v1.21.4b1's [optional PV meter counter for issue #16](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/issues/16), still disabled and unpolled by default. Neither experiment repairs historical statistics.

See the [comparison guide](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/blob/development/docs/house-load-comparisons.md) for precise behaviour and attributes. Please share timestamped comparisons in [issue #10](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/issues/10). Regression validation is simulated; hardware comparison is still required.

Local validation: 518 Python tests passed on HA 2024.12.5/Python 3.12 and HA 2026.10.4/Python 3.14, both with pymodbus 3.7.4, plus 23 frontend tests. The 35 added cases include the public sample-3 recorder excerpt and the genuine short-load limitation.
